home.seo_description: We design, write and ship bespoke digital products. From the foundations to the final polish.
home.hero_sub: We design, write and ship bespoke digital products. From the foundations to the final polish.
home.products_intro: We design them, write them and keep them in production ourselves. The fastest way to see how we work is to use them.

fanta_rainbow.desc: Live fantasy football auctions. The bank keeps the score, players open a link and bid from their phone, the countdown decides.
fanta_rainbow.alt: Fanta Rainbow: a rainbow bolt splits the pitch at night and leaves the logo, with the line Il fantacalcio come non l'hai mai giocato

bin_or_deal.desc: Listings aggregator across European marketplaces for collectors, with an automatic “bin vs deal” score.
bin_or_deal.alt: Bin or Deal: the logo on newsprint, marketplace listings scrolling by and a stamp judging the price, Deal, Fair or Bin

cityfix.desc: Urban regeneration: citizens, councils and suppliers report, manage and resolve interventions across the city.
cityfix.alt: CityFix: the logo and the line Nessuna città è mai finita on a map of Brindisi, with reports around it going from open to taken on to solved

cruciverba_lab.desc: The home of Italian crosswords online. Seven new word games every day, in the browser.
cruciverba_lab.alt: Cruciverba Lab: a crossword grid fills in with CRUCIVERBA and LAB, with the daily games around it like Chiave, Setaccio, Alveare and Nessi

about.title: Didap, in two lines.
about.intro: Five of us, independent: three full-stack engineers, one designer, one project manager. Free the monkey.
about.body_1: We work full-stack for real - backend, frontend, infrastructure, mobile, integrations. No outsourcing on what matters: the code we ship is written, tested and run by us.
about.body_2: Design lives inside the code: built to actually ship, not just look good in slides. Products grow through real use, not the perfect brief.
